Sidharth Malhotra Shares Photo of Foot Injury, Fans Express Concern

Actor Sidharth Malhotra shared a photo on social media showing an injury to his foot. He posted the image himself, making light of the situation with a humorous caption. The post led to concern among his fans, with some offering prayers for his recovery. One report mentioned the incident occurred as he is reportedly expecting to become a father again.
